title: Long-reversal sleeves under the book's BTC-trend design rule (BTC > 200-day mean, fixed in Gen359 D2): 2 trials (A is a FLAGGED re-test of Gen314 with the filter)

trials.A altcoin deleveraging bounce + BTC filt: 60 coins with open-interest data: OI value down > 15% over the 24 h to the daily close AND price down over the same 24 h, BTC above its 200-day mean -> long 0.1 for 2 days, at most 8 open (BTC/ETH excluded: they are in v8.6's delev sleeve)
trials.B daily premium discount + BTC filter: 60 coins: daily mean perp premium z vs its own 90 days (lagged) < -3, BTC above its 200-day mean -> long 0.1 for 3 days, at most 8 open

execution: limit orders (Gen337 rule), Bybit costs and funding
bars: program entry bar (vs the Gen363 book) + robustness (thresholds +-, one day later; every period > 0); passing sleeves enter the book only if the book's 2020-24 Sharpe rises
